text:
olga: Noticed duplicated processing in the onboarding sample when a 429 overlaps a token refresh. Short repro below.

olga: Repro: 1) open streaming POST /v1/chat, 2) mid-stream token expiry, 3) server replies 429 for next chunk, 4) SDK refreshes and immediately replays chunk, 5) server processed both -> duplicate.

ben: do we send any stable op id? sample currently generates per-chunk ids so retries look new.

olga: exactly. Also SDK refresh path does immediate retry (no jitter). That syncs replays across clients during bursts.

rui: quick mitigations: (A) include a stable X-RW-Operation-Id header on the initial request and use same id on retries, (B) add full-jitter on refresh retries: sleep = random(0, base * 2**attempt), base=250ms, cap 10s.

ben: server-side cheap dedupe idea: keep seen operation ids in a small LRU cache for 60s, return 409 on duplicate. We should document the TTL and allow clients to request longer windows via Idempotency-Expiry header (server will clamp).

olga: parity issue: JS/Python/Java SDKs behave differently. We need consistent default: attach Idempotency-Key for mutating calls unless opt-out, and refresh-path should always use full jitter. Also expose a setOperationId helper for streams.

sdk-bot: opened RW-6120: "devex: sampleapp dup on refresh - op-id + jitter + idempotency defaults" assigned to @ben.

rui: sampleapp patch snippet (node):
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${t}`, 'X-RW-Operation-Id': opId } });
// include opId in any retried chunk envelopes
```

ben: QA will add a harness that forces token expiry mid-stream and asserts exactly one server-side action. Also add an opt-in response header `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: accepted|duplicate` behind a feature flag for easier debugging.

olga: action items: ben will push sampleapp PR, rui will prototype jitter change in SDK, I'll update onboarding docs to mention op-id and Idempotency-Expiry.

ben: will also add cross-language checklist for parity and unit tests that assert no immediate retry after refresh. Ping me for pairing. :white_check_mark:
